#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print environment variables classified as credentials/tool-schema/runtime metadata.

Safe by default: values for credential-looking variables are redacted.
Use --show-secrets only if you understand the risk.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass

SENSITIVE_NAME_RE = re.compile(
    r"(TOKEN|KEY|SECRET|PASS|PASSWORD|AUTH|COOKIE|CREDENTIAL|PRIVATE|OPENAI|ANTHROPIC|GITHUB|API|BEARER)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

OPENCLAW_RUNTIME_RE = re.compile(r"^OPENCLAW_", re.IGNORECASE)

# Tool schemas are supplied by the OpenClaw runtime, not by environment variables.
# This list documents the tool names visible to this session at creation time.
KNOWN_TOOL_NAMES = [
    "read",
    "write",
    "edit",
    "exec",
    "process",
    "web_search",
    "web_fetch",
    "browser",
    "canvas",
    "nodes",
    "cron",
    "message",
    "gateway",
    "agents_list",
    "sessions_list",
    "sessions_history",
    "sessions_send",
    "sessions_spawn",
    "subagents",
    "session_status",
    "memory_get",
    "memory_search",
    "tts",
]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ClassifiedVar:
    name: str
    value: str
    category: str
    reason: str
    sensitive: bool = False


def classify(name: str, value: str) -> ClassifiedVar:
    if SENSITIVE_NAME_RE.search(name):
        return ClassifiedVar(
            name=name,
            value=value,
            category="credential-like / sensitive by name",
            reason="name matches token/key/secret/password/auth/API pattern",
            sensitive=True,
        )

    if OPENCLAW_RUNTIME_RE.search(name):
        return ClassifiedVar(
            name=name,
            value=value,
            category="OpenClaw runtime/control variable",
            reason="name starts with OPENCLAW_",
        )

    if name == "PYTHON_SHA256":
        return ClassifiedVar(
            name=name,
            value=value,
            category="checksum / package metadata",
            reason="Python distribution checksum, not a credential",
        )

    return ClassifiedVar(
        name=name,
        value=value,
        category="ordinary process/environment metadata",
        reason="does not match known sensitive or OpenClaw runtime patterns",
    )


def display_value(item: ClassifiedVar, show_secrets: bool) -> str:
    if item.sensitive and not show_secrets:
        return "<redacted>"
    if len(item.value) > 200:
        return item.value[:80] + "…<truncated>"
    return item.value


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--show-secrets",
        action="store_true",
        help="print credential-looking values instead of redacting them",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    print("Environment variable classification")
    print("===================================")
    for name in sorted(os.environ):
        item = classify(name, os.environ[name])
        print(f"{item.name}={display_value(item, args.show_secrets)}")
        print(f"  category: {item.category}")
        print(f"  reason:   {item.reason}")

    print("\nTool schemas")
    print("============")
    print("No environment variables correspond to tool schemas.")
    print("Tool schemas are injected separately by the OpenClaw runtime.")
    print("Known tool names visible when this script was created:")
    for tool in KNOWN_TOOL_NAMES:
        print(f"- {tool}")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
